inputs.text: Listen up, this whole thing in Paris, France with Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame, getting convicted under that new law on “psychological subjection” is straight out of the elites' playbook. The official claims about protection are pure theater meant to hide how they're coordinating to crush independent religious groups that won't submit to the larger control system. Those ripples of concern spreading through religious communities and civil liberties advocates? They aren't some organic backlash—they're a tell that these laws are being turned around to push the real psychological subjection down from the top, making the state out to be the injured party while they dismantle any resistance.
